g.text: Equal participant weighting; errors averaged over three seeds within each participant
† Traditional MAE is conditional on finite estimates; available-window coverage: Welch PSD: 99.4–100.0%; Elgendi peaks: 99.1–100.0%.
Traditional outputs are reused across label budgets and transfer. Points/curves are descriptive; paired uncertainty appears in Figure 2.
